# CareMatch Israel
> Platform connecting families with trusted caregivers, relievers, and nursing professionals across Israel.

## Important pages
- [Home](https://www.carematch.co.in/)
- [Job Board](https://www.carematch.co.in/jobs)
- [Post a Job](https://www.carematch.co.in/jobs/create)

## About CareMatch Israel
CareMatch Israel is a free platform for finding and posting caregiver jobs in Israel. Families can post caregiving positions, and caregivers can browse and apply to open jobs. Direct contact via WhatsApp or phone — no middlemen.

## Key features
- Post caregiver job listings with patient details, requirements, and contact info
- Browse open caregiving positions filtered by area and job type
- Direct WhatsApp and phone contact between families and caregivers
- Available in English and Hebrew

## Coverage areas
- Area 1, Area 2, Area 3 across Israel
- Permanent and reliever (temporary) caregiving positions
- 24/7 care, part-time, and relief assignments
